 NAM vs IRE 2nd ODI, Cricket Tips:  The first ODI between Ireland and Namibia was a low-scoring thriller where Ireland successfully defended 229 runs. In fact, they bowled so well and bowled out Namibia for a score of 174 runs, winning by 55 runs. Gavin Hoey bowled superbly for his 3/29, and Jai Moondra and George Dockreel took two wickets each.
 Ireland will look to take the momentum forward in the second game. The second match will start at 1 PM IST on Saturday at Namibia Cricket Ground. Namibia need to find contributions from their batters, which was a big issue in the first game.

 NAM vs IRE: Ground Pitch Report 
 The wicket in Windhoek is a little patchy, which will have seam and swing movement for the fast bowlers. Seamers will get good bounce, and as the game goes on, the conditions will become tough for batting. Early on the conditions for batting will be better.

 Namibia : Michael van Lingen, Louren Steenkamp, Jan Frylinck, Gerhard Erasmus (c), Zane Green (wk), Jan Nicol Loftie-Eaton, JJ Smit, Waldo Smith, Jack Brassell, Ruben Trumpelmann, Ben Scholtz

 Probable Best Batter

 Today Match Prediction : Ireland have an experienced and skillful lineup. Hence, we predict Ireland to win this game.
